etymologies.etymologyHTML: From live +‎ stock.

definitions.definition: Farm animals; animals domesticated for cultivation.

quote.citation: 2011, Cynthia J. Moss, Harvey Croze, Phyllis C. Lee, The Amboseli Elephants: A Long-Term Perspective on a Long-Lived Mammal, page 297:
quote.text: These spearings were not related to livestock killed but to young boys trying to prove their bravery.
